crosshair.off: Off option beside six colour swatches; transparent Symbol preview crosshair; selecting a colour re-enables it.
crosshair.persistence: Existing per-session choice key accepts Off as well as the existing colours.
crosshair.default: Pale grey remains the new-session default.
crosshair.exports: Preview-only; exported PNG/SVG and artwork colours remain unchanged.
crosshair.layout: Swatches wrap within the preview header at narrow widths.

qart.name: QR design workflow renamed QART in navigation, controls, export and entry actions; QR section and QR format terminology retained.
qart.behaviour: Apply on entry from another workflow or Send to QART. Sliders remain editable; clicking the already-active workflow does not reset them.
qart.resets: QR section resets logo/quiet-zone defaults; Font Symbol resets Backdrop to its QART maximum. Section resets remain independent.
qart.settings: Explicit values restored from saved settings are retained.

scenarios: Crosshair Off, colour re-enable and session reload in both builds
Unchanged PNG/SVG exports and artwork state
Responsive header layout and compact export
QART defaults, re-entry, editable values, reset isolation and settings restoration in both builds
Existing QR palette, Buffer edge, undo/redo, workflow switching and portable QR export
